t: The three that show up regardless of what is claimed
a: آيَةُ الْمُنَافِقِ ثَلاَثٌ إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا وَعَدَ أَخْلَفَ، وَإِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ
p: Āyatu-l-munāfiqi thalāth: idhā ḥaddatha kadhab, wa idhā waʿada akhlaf, wa idhā-ʾtumina khān
m: The sign of the hypocrite is three: when he speaks he lies, when he promises he breaks it, and when he is trusted he betrays.
